domain_specific_rationale: From a Generic Contract Design perspective, CP-017 is essential. provider-request.schema.json is the universal request contract for all generative video engines (e.g. Google Flow, Runway, Kling, Sora, FakeProvider). Retaining flow_track—a parameter specific only to Google Flow automation modes—in the top-level generic ProviderRequest schema polluted the generic provider contract with provider-specific implementation details. Removing flow_track encapsulates track selection within Google Flow adapter configuration and provider_parameters, ensuring provider contract neutrality and adherence to Open-Closed principles.
evidence_citations: review-session/FREEZE_REMEDIATION_V1/REVISED_SPEC_CANDIDATE/02_contracts/provider-request.schema.json:lines 1-113 (Generic Provider Request schema clean of vendor-specific flow_track property)
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-03 (Generic Provider Abstraction) and CAP-18 (Track A / Track B Port Equivalence).
residual_risk: Adapter configurations must supply track routing independently of generic provider payloads. Mitigated by adapter environment configuration in R08 Google Flow Adapter.
